note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026, read again in that of 30 October 2026), Angola, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahweal992j) and average post-tax national income (adiinc992j) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, in AOA of that year, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. Read 2026-10-30. Read again 2026-11-03 from the bulk download of 30 October 2026 (its country files dated 30 October 2026): every row quoted here, its year and its currency label stood as before, and no later year was given. Until 2026-11-03 this note and its sources wrote the variable codes with their age and population parts swapped (ahwealj992 for ahweal992j and adiincj992 for adiinc992j), codes no file of the database holds (its README: type, concept, age group, population, as in sptinc992j), and called adiinc992j post-tax disposable income, which its metadata names post-tax national income ([Post-tax national income]=[Post-tax disposable income]+[Public spending]). The national accounts (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-03: each band's income scaled by households' disposable income over national income), searched again on 2026-11-03 in the statistics office's own accounts for a households' disposable income account from 2019 on, found none: INE Angola (ine.gov.ao), read 2026-11-03: Contas Nacionais directory pages load per session and list no annual sector accounts; the national-accounts press note Publicacao_637708718419415272.pdf (provisional 2014, preliminary 2015) gives GDP by production, expenditure and income only. Web search in Portuguese (contas dos sectores institucionais, famílias, rendimento disponível) found no household account from 2019 on. INE Angola publication pages (www.ine.gov.ao/publicacoes/detalhes/<id>, ids 1-1000 scanned on 2026-11-03, 170 publications from 2014 to 2021): national-accounts titles are quarterly accounts notes only (2020 Q3 to 2021 Q1); no annual sector accounts. INE Angola Contas Nacionais directory pages, with session cookies, read 2026-11-03: they render only the site menu, no document list. Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2025-18 captures of ine.gov.ao (278 URLs), read 2026-11-03: no national-accounts publication pages. Banco Nacional de Angola (www.bna.ao) reset the connection on 2026-11-03. Each band's income stayed the database's post-tax national income, public spending included.
